item.content:encoded:
Are you a communications, marketing, public relations, or digital media professional looking for an opportunity to contribute to the work of the United Nations? The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) is offering a Communications and Marketing Associate volunteer assignment in New Delhi, India. This opportunity is designed for professionals who want to use their communication, content creation, digital marketing, and public relations skills to support initiatives that expand opportunities for young people.

The assignment will support UNICEF’s Generation Unlimited (GenU) initiative and its India-focused platform, YuWaah. These initiatives work to help young people access education, learning opportunities, vocational training, employment, and entrepreneurship. The selected volunteer will contribute to digital communications, website content, social media management, public relations, media engagement, campaign development, and event coordination.

The assignment lasts for 12 months, with the possibility of extension depending on funding, operational needs, and performance. It is based onsite at UNICEF in New Delhi and is advertised as a national UN Volunteer assignment. The selected candidate will receive a monthly Volunteer Living Allowance of INR 56,126.74, along with additional benefits and support outlined in the assignment description.

For professionals interested in youth development, public information, digital communications, and international development, this assignment offers an opportunity to contribute to a major United Nations initiative while gaining experience working with government institutions, private-sector partners, media organizations, civil society, and young people.

Overview of the UNICEF Communications and Marketing Associate Assignment

The following table summarizes the principal details of the opportunity.

  • Organization: United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF)
  • Assignment title: Communications and Marketing Associate
  • Duty station: New Delhi, India
  • Host entity: UNICEF
  • Programme: Generation Unlimited (GenU) and YuWaah
  • Assignment duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension
  • Expected start date: November 16, 2026
  • Work arrangement: Onsite
  • Work schedule: Full-time
  • Volunteer category: Associate UCoS, as listed in the assignment
  • Number of available assignments: One
  • Monthly Volunteer Living Allowance: INR 56,126.74
  • Entry lump sum: USD 350, or the equivalent in Indian rupees
  • Relocation support: USD 175 at the beginning and end of the assignment, subject to the stated conditions
  • Exit allowance: USD 120 for each month served, payable upon successful completion of the contract
  • Annual leave: 2.5 days per month
  • Insurance: Health, life, and permanent disability coverage, including the stated insurance provisions for malicious acts
  • Application deadline: November 10, 2026, at 16:00, according to the advertisement
  • Application method: Through the official United Nations Volunteers recruitment platform

Applicants should review the complete assignment description before applying to confirm the latest requirements, application instructions, and conditions.

About UNICEF: Promoting the Rights and Well-Being of Every Child

The United Nations Children’s Fund is a United Nations organization dedicated to protecting children’s rights and supporting their survival, development, education, health, and well-being. Its work reaches children and families in different circumstances, with particular attention to those who face poverty, discrimination, exclusion, conflict, displacement, and other barriers to opportunity.

UNICEF’s mission is grounded in the principle that every child should have the opportunity to survive, develop, and reach their full potential. The organization works through programmes, advocacy, partnerships, and operational activities to advance children’s rights and address inequalities that prevent children from accessing essential services and opportunities.

Equity is central to this mission. Children do not all begin life with the same resources, support systems, or opportunities. Some experience significant disadvantages because of their social, economic, political, or cultural circumstances. UNICEF seeks to address these inequalities so that children can access the opportunities and protections they need to develop.

The organization’s work also recognizes the importance of investing in disadvantaged communities. Improving access to health services, education, and protection can help children realize their potential while contributing to more stable and equitable societies.

Although this particular assignment focuses on communication and marketing rather than direct service delivery, effective communication helps make development programmes more visible, accessible, and understandable. It can strengthen public awareness, communicate programme results, engage partners, and encourage young people to participate in opportunities designed for them.

Understanding Generation Unlimited and YuWaah

A central responsibility of the selected volunteer will be to support communications and marketing activities connected with Generation Unlimited and YuWaah.

What Is Generation Unlimited?

Generation Unlimited, commonly known as GenU, is a global partnership focused on expanding opportunities for young people aged 10 to 24. Its ambition is to help ensure that every young person is in school, participating in formal or informal learning or training, or employed by 2030.

The initiative recognizes that young people need more than general encouragement to succeed. They need practical access to education, vocational training, employment opportunities, entrepreneurship support, and the networks that help them move from learning to earning.

GenU seeks to bring together different stakeholders, including governments, United Nations organizations, civil society, private-sector institutions, and young people themselves. Through collaboration, these stakeholders can identify challenges, develop solutions, and expand opportunities for young people.

The initiative places particular emphasis on those at risk of being left behind, including girls, young people living in poverty, young people with disabilities, young people on the move, and those affected by conflict or natural disasters.

Communication plays an important role in these efforts. Programmes can only reach their intended audiences effectively when information about their purpose, activities, and opportunities is communicated clearly. Digital platforms, media engagement, public campaigns, and partnerships can help make information available to more young people.

What Is YuWaah?

YuWaah is the India-focused version of Generation Unlimited. Its purpose is to build partnerships and develop solutions that help adolescents and young people access meaningful opportunities.

The initiative aims to support young people in accessing learning opportunities, functional and vocational training, employment, and entrepreneurship. It seeks to encourage solutions that are relevant to the Indian context and can be expanded to reach more people.

YuWaah’s work involves collaboration among different stakeholders, including public institutions, private-sector organizations, civil society, media representatives, and young people.

The Communications, Marketing and Advocacy team helps position YuWaah’s priorities within India’s national context. By communicating the progress and impact of its interventions, the team can strengthen relationships with stakeholders and support advocacy and policy discussions.

The Communications and Marketing Associate will contribute to these activities by supporting the creation and distribution of content, assisting with public relations, coordinating partner communications, and helping develop campaigns across multiple communication channels.

What Will the Communications and Marketing Associate Do?

The selected volunteer will work under the overall guidance of the Chief of GenU, Youth Development Partnerships, with secondary supervision from the Communications and Marketing Specialist of the YuWaah Secretariat.

The assignment combines content production, digital communications, public relations, media coordination, campaign support, and event organization. It requires someone who can communicate clearly, work with different stakeholders, manage multiple tasks, and contribute creative ideas.

1. Develop Content for Digital Media Channels

One of the main responsibilities will be supporting content development for YuWaah’s digital media channels, website, and mailing lists.

This work may involve helping prepare content that communicates programme activities, shares updates, highlights results, and promotes opportunities relevant to young people.

Depending on the team’s needs, content development may include:

  • Preparing written content for digital platforms.
  • Supporting website updates and online communications.
  • Assisting with email and mailing-list communications.
  • Helping develop messages for specific audiences.
  • Editing and reviewing content for clarity and accuracy.
  • Supporting the preparation of communication materials for campaigns.
  • Contributing ideas for engaging and informative content.

Strong writing and editing skills will be important because the communication materials must present information in a clear, professional, and accessible way.

The volunteer should also be comfortable adapting messages for different audiences. Content intended for young people may require a different style from material prepared for government representatives, journalists, institutional partners, or other professional stakeholders.

2. Support Social Media and Digital Communications

The assignment includes supporting YuWaah’s digital media presence. Social media can help development initiatives reach young people, communicate programme information, share stories, and engage audiences in discussions about education, training, employment, and entrepreneurship.

The volunteer will contribute to the development of content and other digital communication activities intended to strengthen YuWaah’s online visibility.

Relevant activities may include preparing social media materials, supporting digital campaigns, coordinating content, and helping ensure that information is communicated consistently across platforms.

The assignment also calls for digital support across teams. This includes assisting with the hosting of digital sessions and managing livestreams on platforms such as Facebook and YouTube.

These responsibilities require attention to detail, technical confidence, and the ability to coordinate activities with colleagues. Digital sessions and livestreams often involve several moving parts, including preparation, scheduling, content coordination, technical checks, and communication with participants.

Candidates who have experience with social media platforms, online publishing, digital events, and content management may find these responsibilities particularly relevant.

3. Execute the Public Relations Strategy

Another important responsibility is supporting the implementation of YuWaah’s public relations strategy.

Public relations helps an organization communicate with the public and maintain relationships with media organizations, partners, and other stakeholders. In a development setting, it can help explain programme objectives, communicate progress, and increase awareness of initiatives.

The volunteer will assist with coordination involving journalists and internal stakeholders. The assignment also includes developing key messages and preparing media-facing materials, such as press releases and opinion-editorial articles.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting coordination with journalists.
  • Assisting internal stakeholders with communication materials.
  • Helping develop clear and consistent key messages.
  • Contributing to press releases and other media materials.
  • Supporting the preparation of opinion-editorial articles.
  • Helping communicate programme activities and results.
  • Ensuring that communication materials are professionally written and appropriately edited.

This work requires strong writing, research, analytical, and interpersonal skills. The volunteer must be able to present information accurately and understand how different audiences may interpret a message.

Experience in media relations, public relations, advocacy, journalism, communications, or content development may be useful for this part of the assignment.

4. Assist in Organizing Events and Convenings

The selected volunteer will also play an active role in organizing convenings and events.

Events can bring together young people, public institutions, private-sector partners, civil society organizations, media representatives, and other stakeholders. They may provide opportunities to discuss programme priorities, share experiences, strengthen partnerships, and explore solutions to challenges facing young people.

Supporting these activities requires coordination, planning, communication, and time management.

The volunteer may assist the team with event-related preparations and communication tasks, depending on the needs of each activity. These responsibilities require the ability to manage details while working with different people and teams.

Candidates who have supported conferences, workshops, stakeholder meetings, public campaigns, webinars, or community events may find their experience relevant.

5. Coordinate Partner Communications

YuWaah’s work depends on relationships with multiple stakeholders. The assignment description identifies the importance of communication with partners, including government counterparts, other United Nations agencies, private-sector representatives, and young people.

The volunteer will support partner communication and contribute to the coordination of communication activities.

Effective partner communication helps ensure that stakeholders receive accurate information, understand programme priorities, and remain informed about relevant activities.

The role requires professionalism, tact, cultural sensitivity, and strong interpersonal skills. The successful candidate should be able to work constructively with people from different professional, cultural, and institutional backgrounds.

6. Contribute to Multichannel Campaigns Focused on Young People

The assignment also involves conceptualizing new campaigns across multiple communication channels, particularly campaigns that use youth-focused content.

A multichannel campaign communicates a message through more than one platform or medium. Depending on the campaign, this could involve a combination of websites, social media, email communications, public relations, video content, and events.

The objective is to communicate messages effectively and reach audiences through appropriate channels.

The volunteer will help the team develop and support these communication activities. Creativity, knowledge of current digital trends, an understanding of audience needs, and the ability to produce engaging content will be valuable.

The youth focus is particularly important because communication should reflect the interests, needs, and experiences of the people the programme is intended to serve.

7. Support Monitoring, Reporting, and Knowledge Management

The expected outputs include supporting the monitoring of progress and preparing monthly reports for YuWaah Communications.

Monitoring and reporting help communication teams understand whether their activities are progressing as planned. They can also help teams document completed work, identify areas for improvement, and communicate results to relevant stakeholders.

The volunteer will work with country and state office teams and national counterparts to help ensure that YuWaah’s objectives and approaches are understood and applied.

The assignment may therefore require the ability to organize information, prepare reports, communicate progress, and work collaboratively across teams.

Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, accuracy, and proficiency with common office applications will be useful in carrying out these responsibilities.

Expected Outputs and Results

The selected candidate will contribute to the work of UNICEF and the YuWaah Secretariat by providing timely, responsive, professional, and high-quality support.

The assignment description identifies several expected results.

Stronger Social Media Presence

The volunteer will help support the development of a solid social media presence for YuWaah. This involves contributing to digital communications that help the initiative share information and engage its intended audiences.

Preparation of Media and Creative Materials

The volunteer will assist with the preparation of media collateral, social media creatives, video production activities, and other communication materials.

These materials can help explain programme activities, communicate key messages, and improve the visibility of initiatives supporting young people.

Coordination Across Teams and Stakeholders

The volunteer will work closely with country and state office teams and national counterparts to support the understanding and application of YuWaah’s priorities.

This collaboration is important because communication activities must be consistent with programme objectives and coordinated with the people responsible for implementing the initiative.

Monitoring Progress and Preparing Reports

The volunteer will support the monitoring of communication activities and the preparation of monthly reports.

This work helps the team document progress and maintain an organized record of communication efforts.

Together, these expected outputs show that the assignment is not limited to posting on social media. It combines creative communication with coordination, public relations, event support, reporting, and collaboration.

Required Qualifications and Educational Background

Applicants should carefully review the formal eligibility criteria and professional requirements before submitting an application.

Educational Qualification

The assignment requires a bachelor’s degree in one of the following areas or a related field:

  • Integrated Marketing Communications.
  • Digital Marketing.
  • Content Marketing.
  • Brand Marketing.
  • Public Relations.
  • Communication.
  • A related discipline.

Candidates should demonstrate how their education relates to the responsibilities of the assignment.

For example, a degree in communications may provide a foundation in writing, media relations, public messaging, and communication strategy. A degree focused on digital marketing may provide relevant knowledge of digital platforms, online campaigns, audience engagement, and content performance.

The assignment specifically lists the degree areas above or related domains. Applicants should not assume that an unrelated qualification will automatically satisfy the requirement.

Professional Experience

The assignment information lists two years of relevant experience in marketing and/or communications under the skills and experience section.

Relevant experience may include work involving:

  • Digital marketing and social media.
  • Communication strategy and content development.
  • Public relations and media engagement.
  • Marketing campaigns.
  • Website content and digital publishing.
  • Graphic design and creative communication materials.
  • Video and multimedia content.
  • Advocacy and public information.
  • Communication-related reporting and monitoring.
  • Partnership development and stakeholder networking.

The assignment also identifies developing-country work or field experience as an asset.

Applicants should emphasize experience that directly demonstrates their ability to carry out the responsibilities described in the advertisement. Relevant internships, professional roles, and other documented communications experience may help applicants explain their capabilities, although the official recruitment platform should be consulted for how different types of experience are assessed.

Important: The assignment page separately displays a general required-experience field of one month and a relevant-experience requirement of two years. Because these entries differ, candidates should consult the official vacancy page for clarification rather than assuming that the shorter figure replaces the two-year professional requirement.

Required Language Skills

The assignment requires fluency in both English and Hindi.

  • English: Fluent — required.
  • Hindi: Fluent — required.

Applicants should take these requirements seriously because the role involves content development, media communications, stakeholder coordination, reporting, and other tasks that require clear written and spoken communication.

Fluency in the required languages will be particularly relevant when preparing communication materials, coordinating with partners, and working with different audiences.

The vacancy does not list English alone as sufficient. Candidates should verify that they meet both language requirements before applying.

Technical and Professional Skills

Beyond formal education and experience, the assignment identifies a broad range of technical and professional capabilities.

Content Creation and Editing

The candidate should be able to develop, edit, and review communication materials with accuracy and creativity. The ability to turn information into clear, audience-appropriate content is important for digital communications and public relations.

Graphic Design and Creative Production

The description highlights the ability to conceptualize and develop communication materials. Experience with graphic design, social media creatives, video content, and other media formats may be valuable.

Knowledge of Digital Trends and Tools

Applicants should understand current communication trends, tools, and formats. Digital communication changes rapidly, and professionals need to adapt their approaches to evolving platforms and audience expectations.

The assignment also identifies the ability to learn and adopt new software and tools, including artificial intelligence tools.

Research and Analytical Skills

The candidate should be able to research information, analyze communication needs, support campaign development, and contribute to monitoring and reporting.

Analytical skills are useful when organizing information, evaluating progress, preparing reports, and supporting communication decisions.

Writing and Reporting

Excellent oral and written communication skills are required. The description specifically highlights drafting, formulation, reporting, accuracy, and the ability to prepare clear communication materials.

Partnership Development and Networking

The role involves working with a wide range of stakeholders. The ability to establish relationships, coordinate with partners, and communicate professionally will be important.

Computer Literacy

The assignment requires solid general computer literacy, including proficiency in common Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel. Familiarity with email, the internet, database management, and office technology is also identified.

Independence and Time Management

The candidate should be self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision. The assignment may involve multiple concurrent tasks and tight deadlines, making planning, prioritization, organization, and problem-solving important.

Personal Qualities and UN Values

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate professional competence and alignment with the values of UNICEF and the United Nations Volunteers programme.

Professionalism

Professionalism includes understanding the responsibilities of the assignment, applying sound judgment, handling information appropriately, and communicating with tact and discretion.

The volunteer should be able to take initiative, work independently when necessary, and provide reliable support to colleagues and stakeholders.

Integrity

Integrity involves acting in accordance with ethical standards and the values of the United Nations and UNICEF. It includes avoiding personal gain at the expense of professional responsibilities and responding appropriately to unethical conduct.

Teamwork and Respect for Diversity

The assignment requires the ability to work across organizational boundaries and maintain positive professional relationships.

The candidate should be respectful of differences in culture, gender, religion, nationality, age, and other backgrounds. The description also emphasizes gender equality and inclusive participation.

Commitment to Continuous Learning

The volunteer should be willing to learn new skills, keep up with developments in communications and marketing, and adapt to changes in the working environment.

Planning and Organization

The candidate should be capable of managing multiple activities, establishing priorities, meeting deadlines, and coordinating work efficiently.

Communication

Strong interpersonal, written, and spoken communication skills are essential. The volunteer should be able to explain ideas clearly, prepare reports, present options, and communicate with people from different backgrounds.

Flexibility and Adaptability

The assignment description emphasizes adaptability and a willingness to work in potentially challenging conditions. Applicants should review the full requirements and consider the practical demands of an onsite national volunteer assignment.

Commitment to Volunteering

The candidate should demonstrate a genuine commitment to voluntary engagement, solidarity, compassion, reciprocity, and self-reliance, as well as a commitment to UNICEF’s mission and vision and the United Nations’ core values.

Financial Benefits and Volunteer Allowances

The assignment provides a Volunteer Living Allowance and additional benefits intended to help cover living expenses and certain costs associated with the assignment.

These payments should not automatically be interpreted as a conventional employee salary. The position is advertised as a national UN Volunteer assignment, and the financial arrangements are described in terms of volunteer allowances and benefits.

1. Monthly Volunteer Living Allowance

The assignment provides a monthly Volunteer Living Allowance of INR 56,126.74.

According to the vacancy description, the allowance is intended to cover housing, utilities, and normal living expenses.

Because the assignment is based in New Delhi, applicants should consider local housing costs, transportation, food, and other expenses when evaluating whether the allowance will meet their needs.

2. Entry Lump Sum

The selected volunteer is eligible for a one-time entry lump sum of USD 350, paid in the equivalent amount in Indian rupees.

This payment is intended to provide initial support at the beginning of the assignment.

3. Relocation Support

The assignment lists relocation payments of USD 175 at the beginning and end of the assignment, subject to the condition that the duty station is outside commuting distance as determined by UNV.

Applicants should verify their eligibility for this payment and the applicable arrangements before making relocation plans.

4. Exit Allowance

The vacancy lists an exit allowance of USD 120 for each month served, payable upon successful completion of the contract.

The allowance is subject to the stated completion condition. Applicants should review the full UNV terms to understand how the payment is calculated and administered.

5. Insurance Coverage

The assignment includes insurance provisions covering health, life, and permanent disability, as well as the listed coverage for malicious acts.

The vacancy also states that health insurance can cover up to three dependents, except for UN Community Volunteers.

Candidates should consult the applicable UNV insurance documentation for the complete terms, exclusions, and eligibility conditions.

6. Annual Leave

The selected volunteer will receive 2.5 days of annual leave per month, according to the assignment description.

Applicants should confirm the applicable leave procedures and how leave is administered during the assignment.

7. Learning and Career Development Resources

The assignment provides access to UN Volunteers’ learning and career development resources.

These resources may support professional development and help volunteers build knowledge and skills during their assignments.

Summary of Financial Benefits

Benefit Amount or provision
Monthly Volunteer Living Allowance INR 56,126.74
Entry lump sum USD 350, or equivalent in INR
Relocation support USD 175 at the beginning and end, subject to conditions
Exit allowance USD 120 per month served, payable upon successful contract completion
Insurance Health, life, permanent disability, and stated malicious-acts coverage
Annual leave 2.5 days per month
Learning Access to UNV learning and career development resources

These figures are taken from the assignment description. Applicants should check the official vacancy and applicable UNV terms for confirmation before making financial or relocation decisions.

Work Location and Living Conditions in New Delhi, India

The assignment is based in New Delhi, India’s capital, and is expected to be performed onsite at UNICEF.

New Delhi is a major administrative, cultural, and commercial centre. It has modern amenities, transport connections, and a large community of professionals working in diplomatic missions, international organizations, multinational companies, and foreign businesses.

The vacancy describes the city as a large and rapidly changing metropolitan area, with a short, moderate winter and a long, hot summer.

Because the assignment is onsite, the selected volunteer should be prepared to live in or near the duty station and commute to the workplace as required.

Housing and Daily Living Arrangements

The assignment description states that national UN Volunteers are responsible for arranging their own housing and other living essentials.

The monthly Volunteer Living Allowance is intended to help cover housing, utilities, and normal living expenses, but candidates should assess their expected costs carefully.

Before accepting the assignment, applicants should consider:

  • Accommodation costs in New Delhi.
  • Daily transportation to and from the workplace.
  • Food and household expenses.
  • Local transportation and communication costs.
  • Personal expenses and emergency savings.
  • The practical requirements of relocating to or residing in New Delhi.

The volunteer should also be prepared to demonstrate cultural sensitivity and adapt to local traditions and working practices.

Contract Duration and Extension

The assignment is scheduled to last 12 months, beginning on November 16, 2026, according to the vacancy information.

An extension may be possible, but it is not guaranteed. The assignment description states that extensions depend on funding availability, operational requirements, and satisfactory performance.

Applicants should therefore plan around the stated 12-month duration rather than assuming that the opportunity will continue beyond the original contract.

How to Apply for the UNICEF Communications and Marketing Associate Assignment

Interested applicants should apply through the official United Nations Volunteers recruitment platform and follow the instructions provided for this specific assignment.

Official application platform: United Nations Volunteers

Applicants should locate the vacancy titled Communications and Marketing Associate, with UNICEF as the host entity and New Delhi, India, as the duty station. Because recruitment details can change, candidates should confirm that the vacancy is still open before preparing or submitting an application.

Step 1: Review the Official Vacancy

Read the complete assignment description and confirm that you meet the educational, professional, language, and nationality or residency requirements.

Pay particular attention to the requirement for a bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, or a related field; the stated two years of relevant experience; and fluency in both English and Hindi.

Step 2: Prepare Your Application Information

Prepare accurate information about your education, work history, professional skills, and relevant experience.

Your application should demonstrate how your background relates to the duties listed in the vacancy.

Relevant experience may include digital communications, marketing, public relations, social media management, content production, graphic design, media coordination, event support, and communication-related reporting.

Step 3: Highlight Relevant Achievements

When describing previous experience, focus on specific responsibilities and results that demonstrate your capabilities.

For example, if applicable to your actual experience, you may describe campaigns you supported, digital content you produced, communication materials you developed, events you coordinated, or partnerships you helped maintain.

Do not claim skills, achievements, language fluency, or experience that you cannot substantiate.

Step 4: Demonstrate Your Communication Skills

Because communication is central to the role, ensure that your application materials are clear, accurate, and professionally written.

Explain how your skills can support YuWaah’s work with young people and its communications, marketing, advocacy, and public relations activities.

Step 5: Submit Before the Deadline

The advertised deadline is November 10, 2026, at 16:00.

Submit your application through the official recruitment platform before the deadline and follow any instructions about required fields or supporting documents.

The vacancy is advertised as a competitive recruitment process, and only one assignment is available. Meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee selection.

Apply here

Important Information Before Applying

Before applying, candidates should review several conditions that may affect their eligibility or ability to accept the assignment.

First, this is a national assignment. The vacancy states that candidates must be nationals, legal residents, or hold refugee status in the country of assignment. Since the duty station is in India, applicants should confirm that they meet the applicable condition.

Second, both English and Hindi are required at fluent level. Applicants who do not meet the stated language requirements may not be suitable for the position.

Third, the professional experience entries should be clarified. The assignment page lists one month in a general required-experience field but specifies two years of relevant experience in its detailed requirements. Applicants should use the detailed official vacancy and seek clarification through the recruitment platform if needed.

Fourth, housing is the volunteer’s responsibility. The assignment provides a monthly living allowance, but applicants should independently evaluate accommodation and living costs in New Delhi.

Fifth, the allowance is not a guarantee of employment beyond the assignment. The role is a volunteer assignment with a stated duration of 12 months. Any extension depends on the conditions described in the vacancy.

Finally, applicants should use official recruitment channels. The United Nations does not charge application, processing, training, interviewing, testing, or other recruitment fees. Anyone asked to pay a fee in connection with the recruitment process should treat the request as suspicious and verify it through official channels.

Why This Assignment May Be Valuable for Communications Professionals

This opportunity brings together communication, marketing, advocacy, youth development, and international cooperation.

For a professional who meets the requirements, the assignment may offer several forms of experience.

Experience in an International Development Setting

Working with UNICEF can provide exposure to communication activities connected with a major international development organization. The volunteer will support a programme that works with multiple stakeholders and focuses on expanding opportunities for young people.

Practical Digital Communications Experience

The assignment includes content development, social media support, website communications, livestreaming, and digital campaign activities.

These responsibilities can help a qualified candidate apply communication skills in a professional setting and work across different digital channels.

Public Relations and Media Coordination

Supporting press releases, opinion-editorial materials, key messages, and journalist coordination may provide valuable experience for professionals interested in public relations, media communications, advocacy, or public information.

Youth-Focused Campaigns

The role emphasizes communication focused on young people. This provides an opportunity to contribute to messages and campaigns related to learning, skills development, employment, and entrepreneurship.

Stakeholder Collaboration

The volunteer will work with colleagues and support communication involving different partners. This can provide practical exposure to coordination across teams and institutions.

Reporting and Professional Development

Supporting monthly reporting and monitoring can help strengthen organizational, analytical, and documentation skills. Access to UNV learning and career development resources is also listed among the assignment benefits.

The value of the experience will depend on the responsibilities undertaken, the quality of the candidate’s contributions, and the learning achieved during the assignment.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is the UNICEF Communications and Marketing Associate assignment?

It is a 12-month national UN Volunteer assignment with UNICEF in New Delhi, India. The selected volunteer will support communications and marketing activities for Generation Unlimited and YuWaah.

2. What is the application deadline?

The advertised deadline is November 10, 2026, at 16:00. Applicants should verify the deadline and time zone on the official vacancy page.

3. When is the expected start date?

The assignment description lists November 16, 2026, as the expected start date.

4. How long does the assignment last?

The assignment lasts 12 months, with the possibility of extension depending on funding, operational requirements, and satisfactory performance.

5. What is the monthly allowance?

The assignment lists a monthly Volunteer Living Allowance of INR 56,126.74 to help cover housing, utilities, and normal living expenses.

6. Is this a remote opportunity?

No. The assignment is listed as onsite, with the duty station at UNICEF in New Delhi, India.

7. What degree is required?

The vacancy requires a bachelor’s degree in Integrated Marketing Communications, Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, Brand Marketing, Public Relations, Communication, or a related domain.

8. How much professional experience is required?

The detailed requirements list two years of experience in marketing and/or communications. However, the advertisement also displays a separate general required-experience field of one month. Applicants should consult the official vacancy for clarification.

9. Which languages are required?

Fluency in both English and Hindi is required.

10. Can applicants from outside India apply?

The vacancy is classified as a national assignment and states that candidates must be nationals, legal residents, or hold refugee status in the country of assignment. Since the assignment is in India, applicants must verify that they satisfy the applicable national-assignment eligibility conditions.

11. Does the assignment include insurance?

Yes. The description lists health, life, and permanent disability coverage, along with the stated provisions for malicious-acts insurance. Applicants should consult the official terms for the full details.

12. Is the position a permanent job?

The vacancy describes a 12-month national UN Volunteer assignment, with a possible extension subject to conditions. It should not be treated as a permanent employment offer.

13. Is there an application fee?

The assignment’s scam warning states that the United Nations does not charge application, processing, training, interviewing, testing, or other recruitment fees. Applicants should use official recruitment channels and avoid paying anyone who claims to guarantee selection.

Conclusion

The UNICEF Communications and Marketing Associate assignment in New Delhi is an opportunity for qualified communications and marketing professionals to contribute to youth-focused initiatives through digital content, social media, public relations, campaign development, event support, partner coordination, and reporting.

The selected volunteer will support Generation Unlimited and YuWaah, initiatives intended to expand young people’s access to learning, vocational training, employment, and entrepreneurship opportunities. The assignment offers a 12-month onsite placement, a monthly Volunteer Living Allowance of INR 56,126.74, additional specified allowances, insurance provisions, annual leave, and access to UNV learning and career development resources.

Applicants should carefully evaluate the requirements before applying. The vacancy calls for a relevant bachelor’s degree, two years of marketing and/or communications experience under the detailed requirements, and fluency in both English and Hindi. It is a national assignment in India, so candidates must also meet the applicable nationality, legal residency, or refugee-status requirement.

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 16:00, according to the advertisement. Interested candidates should review the official vacancy, confirm the eligibility conditions, and submit their applications through the United Nations Volunteers recruitment platform before the stated deadline.

item.content:encoded:
The United Nations Online Volunteering Program offers people around the world the opportunity to contribute their skills, knowledge, and expertise to global development and humanitarian efforts remotely. Managed by the United Nations Volunteers (UNV) programme, this initiative allows volunteers to support United Nations agencies, governments, public institutions, and civil society organizations online from any location.

Whether you are a student, graduate, young professional, freelancer, or experienced expert, the UN Online Volunteering Program provides a flexible way to gain international experience, support meaningful causes, and contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) without traveling abroad.

Applicants from all countries can participate, and there is no application fee.

Key Summary of the UN Online Volunteering Program

Program Details Information
Host Organization United Nations Volunteers (UNV)
Program Type Online / Virtual Volunteering
Location Fully Remote
Eligible Applicants Open Worldwide
Age Requirement 18 Years and Above
Duration Up to 12 Weeks
Weekly Commitment Up to 20 Hours Per Week
Application Fee None
Certificate Official UN Certificate of Appreciation
Deadline Open Year-Round

What is the UN Online Volunteering Program?

The UN Online Volunteering Program is a global platform that connects volunteers with organizations working in sustainable development, humanitarian action, education, climate action, youth empowerment, gender equality, health, communications, and many other fields.

Through the platform, volunteers can contribute remotely to projects and assignments requiring different skills and expertise. Assignments are available in areas such as:

  • Research and data analysis
  • Graphic design
  • Translation and interpretation
  • Social media management
  • Content writing and editing
  • Communications and advocacy
  • Teaching and training
  • Web development
  • Project support
  • Administrative assistance

The program enables volunteers to collaborate virtually with organizations worldwide while building practical international development experience.

Why Apply for the UN Online Volunteering Program?

The UN Online Volunteering Program is one of the best remote international volunteering opportunities available for students and professionals seeking global exposure and meaningful impact.

1. Gain International Experience

Volunteers work with organizations engaged in development and humanitarian projects around the world. This provides valuable international exposure and practical experience.

2. Build Your CV and Professional Profile

Having United Nations volunteering experience on your CV can strengthen applications for jobs, internships, scholarships, fellowships, and graduate programs.

3. Work Remotely from Anywhere

The program is fully online, allowing participants to volunteer from home without relocation or travel expenses.

4. Receive an Official UN Certificate

Volunteers who successfully complete their assignments receive an electronic certificate of appreciation from the organization they supported.

5. Expand Your Global Network

Participants connect with professionals, organizations, and changemakers from different countries and sectors.

6. Support the Sustainable Development Goals

Volunteers contribute directly to global efforts focused on poverty reduction, education, gender equality, climate action, peacebuilding, and sustainable development.

Eligibility Criteria for the UN Online Volunteering Program 2026

The program is designed to be accessible and inclusive. Applicants from all academic and professional backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

To become an online volunteer, applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Be able to work remotely
  • Have access to the internet and a digital device
  • Demonstrate motivation to support social impact and development initiatives
  • Meet any specific requirements listed for individual assignments

There are no strict academic qualifications required for general participation. Each volunteering assignment may have its own preferred skills or experience.

Duration and Commitment

Online volunteering assignments are flexible and vary depending on the organization’s needs.

Key participation details include:

  • Maximum duration: 12 weeks
  • Maximum workload: 20 hours per week
  • Fully remote collaboration
  • Flexible scheduling depending on the assignment

Organizations can engage up to 25 online volunteers per assignment.

Benefits of the UN Online Volunteering Program

Participants in the program can benefit in several ways:

  • International volunteering experience
  • Practical skill development
  • Exposure to UN-related projects
  • Networking opportunities with global organizations
  • Flexible remote work experience
  • Official recognition certificate
  • Contribution to meaningful social impact initiatives
  • Experience working in multicultural environments

Required Documents

To apply for the UN Online Volunteering Program, applicants generally need:

  • A completed online volunteer profile
  • Personal information and contact details
  • A summary of skills and experience
  • Areas of interest and expertise

Depending on the assignment, organizations may also request:

  • CV or resume
  • Portfolio
  • Writing samples
  • Language certifications
  • Other supporting documents

How the UN Online Volunteering Process Works

The process is straightforward and accessible to applicants worldwide.

Step 1: Organizations Register

Eligible organizations, including UN agencies, NGOs, and public institutions, register on the volunteering platform.

Step 2: Assignments are Published

Organizations submit volunteer assignments outlining the required tasks and skills.

Step 3: Volunteers Apply

Interested volunteers browse available assignments and submit applications for opportunities matching their interests and expertise.

Step 4: Organizations Select Volunteers

Organizations review applications and select suitable candidates.

Step 5: Online Collaboration Begins

Selected volunteers work remotely with the host organization throughout the assignment period.

Step 6: Certificate Issued

Upon successful completion, volunteers receive an official certificate of appreciation.

How to Apply for the UN Online Volunteering Program 2026

Interested applicants can apply online through the official UN Online Volunteering platform.

Application Steps

  1. Visit the official UN Unified Volunteering Platform (UVP).
  2. Create a volunteer profile
  3. Complete your personal and professional information
  4. Browse available assignments
  5. Apply for assignments matching your skills and interests
  6. Wait for the organization’s response
  7. Begin volunteering remotely if selected

Official Website

Applicants can access the official platform here:

UN Online Volunteering Platform

Final Thoughts

The UN Online Volunteering Program 2026 is an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking flexible international experience while contributing to global development efforts. With assignments available year-round and open to applicants worldwide, the program allows volunteers to use their talents to support impactful initiatives from anywhere in the world.

Whether you are looking to build professional experience, strengthen your CV, develop new skills, or contribute to meaningful causes, the UN Online Volunteering Program provides a valuable pathway to engage with global humanitarian and development work remotely.

Looking for more volunteer opportunities worldwide, please visit https://opportunitiesforyouth.org/?s=volunteer

item.content:encoded:
Africa’s innovation ecosystem continues to grow, creating new opportunities for young entrepreneurs, technology enthusiasts, researchers, and aspiring business leaders to develop solutions to the continent’s challenges. However, turning an innovative idea into a successful venture often requires more than creativity. Innovators also need access to experienced professionals who can share practical knowledge, provide guidance, and help them navigate the challenges of developing and growing their ideas.

The timbuktoo Africa UniPods Mentor Network is inviting experienced professionals to contribute to this growing innovation ecosystem by joining its pro bono mentorship network. The initiative seeks to bring together artificial intelligence (AI) and technology experts, industry specialists, and business leaders who can guide innovators across more than 20 African countries.

This opportunity is designed for professionals who want to share their expertise, support emerging innovators, and contribute to the development of Africa’s technology and entrepreneurship ecosystem. By volunteering their knowledge and experience, mentors can help innovators think through challenges, strengthen their ideas, and make progress towards developing solutions with practical value.

Applications are open until 15 November 2026. Interested professionals can apply through the application link provided in the announcement.

About the timbuktoo Africa UniPods Mentor Network

The timbuktoo Africa UniPods Mentor Network is a pan-African mentorship initiative that aims to connect innovators with experienced people who can provide professional guidance and knowledge in relevant fields.

The network brings together individuals with different areas of expertise, including AI, technology, specialised industries, and business leadership. This broad range of experience can help innovators access perspectives that extend beyond technical development and cover the wider process of building, testing, and advancing new ideas.
